summary: All three requested features VERIFIED on live 390x844 preview. (1) BOTTOM TAB BAR: outer tabbar container is 62pt tall (bottom:844, top:782) — matches spec 56+bottomInset(0)+6 on web. Inner tablist row is 49pt centered inside with paddingTop:8/paddingBottom:4. Labels+icons fully visible, no clipping. Verified via DOM measure on the fixed-position ancestor of role=tablist. (2) GET YOUR STORE TAB: label 'Get Your Store' renders (storefront-outline icon); the old 'RFQ' label does NOT appear on the tab bar. Tapping the tab does NOT navigate to /rfq (URL stayed on /home) and Linking.openURL('https://montezinfobyte.com/get-your-store') is invoked — captured through window.open interception. Note: React Navigation's web renderer does NOT forward `tabBarTestID` prop as `data-testid` on tab items — tab items expose role='tab' + href='/rfq'; this is a web-only quirk (works in native builds). (3) RFQ SCREEN STILL REACHABLE: Products → first product card → 'Request Quote' button routes to /rfq?productSlug=…&productName=…&category=…; RFQ form testIDs all present (rfq-name-input, rfq-email-input, rfq-phone-input, rfq-category-input, rfq-quantity-input, rfq-description-input, rfq-submit-button, rfq-back-button). tabPress listener does not interfere with programmatic router.push. (4) SITE FOOTER on Home: site-footer, footer-logo (Montez Infobyte brand), footer-about, footer-quick-links (About/Products/Get Your Store/Contact), footer-column-contact ('+91 7639533953', 'montez.spprt@gmail.com'), footer-column-address (Chennai lines), footer-socials with footer-social-facebook/instagram/linkedin, footer-copyright '© 2026 Montez Infobyte Private Limited. All rights reserved.' Verified via 29 testIDs collected from DOM. (5) FOOTER ADMIN-MANAGEABLE: pytest test_admin_patch_updates_footer PUTs {footer:{about,copyright,quickLinks,contactColumns,socials}} with X-Admin-Token: montez-admin-2026 → GET /api/cms/footer reflects the new values; legacy /api/mobile/cms.cms.footer also matches. (6) Cleanup: removed a duplicate `app.include_router(api_router)` + `add_middleware(CORSMiddleware)` block that lingered at lines 395-409 of server.py (post first assemble). Backend restarts cleanly. BACKEND PYTEST: 22/22 passing in 2s (10 mobile_api + 6 cms_split + 3 upstream_auth + 3 new footer tests). Upstream `/api/cms/footer` returns 404 today, so the frontend correctly falls through to local `/api/cms/footer` — verified footer body on live UI matches local seeded values. REGRESSIONS clean: home banner is image-only (no overlay), splash logo, home logo, announcement pill 'Get Discount', stats block, 8 featured product cards, product detail, RFQ form all render correctly. Carried-over non-blocking RN warnings persist (shadow*/style.resizeMode/pointerEvents from expo-router).
